quote: We propose an adversarial iterative generation approach for crafting fake news capable of deceiving high-performing detectors.

...We implement filtering protocols as an additional safeguard to reduce invalid generation. ... We start with a trusted news corpus T , which contains real-time news ... We independently rewrite each news τ i ∈ T to generate multiple fake news candidates ... The generator receives feedback in the form of a rationale from a retrieval-augmented detector ... the generator revises the text to undermine the prior rationale and avoid detection...
We propose an adversarial iterative generation approach for crafting fake news capable of deceiving high-performing detectors.
outputs: Fake news articles generated by rewriting true news
The paper generates fake news instances by rewriting real news with factual errors, producing 402 fake news outputs from 402 true news seeds.

quote: We adopt AUC-ROC as the main metric to evaluate the effectiveness of a detector

...Evaluation results (Table ) show that our adversarial iterative generation pipeline can produce fake news that can deceive strong LLM-based detectors. ... We report AUC-ROC scores of different retrieval-free detectors on recent LLM-generated fake news datasets ...
We adopt AUC-ROC as the main metric to evaluate the effectiveness of a detector as it quantifies the model's capability to classify across various thresholds.

We run a set of LLM-based detectors using simple zero-shot prompting ... Please predict the plausibility of the following news story: <news/> Please give a number representing the plausibility (1-10) and nothing else.

...We prompt the models to assign a plausibility score (on a scale of 1-10, from implausible to plausible) to a given news item in a zero-shot setting. These scores are normalized to the [0, 1] range when computing metrics... We also generate rationales via a separate LLM call.
